title: Branch-free maximum and clamp
description:
Compute max, min, absolute value and a clamp without any jumps.

```
a, b: 7 -12
max 7, min -12, abs(b) 12
clamp(b, 0, 10) = 0
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "a, b: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        call    read_int
        mov     rbx, rax
        call    read_int
        mov     r12, rax
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `mov rax, rbx` / `cmp rax, r12` / `cmovl rax, r12` leaves the larger in `rax` (lesson 3.05).
For abs: `mov rax, r12` / `neg rax` / `cmovl rax, r12`: if the negated value is negative, the original was positive.
requirements: Use `cmp` with `cmovl`/`cmovg` only; no `j` instructions between reading and printing.
stretch: Write `sign(x)` (-1, 0 or 1) with two `setcc` instructions and a `sub`.
